correctness.rationale: A concept is uniquely determined by its extent and every extent is an intersection of columns, including the empty intersection G. A proper coatom can be obtained only if some chosen supra-coatom column is that coatom; conversely all coatoms meet-generate the full power set. This includes r=1 and m=0. Each of the r disjoint coatom types has per-column probability t and 0<rt≤1, so exclusion of j types has probability (1−jt)^m. Inclusion–exclusion and ordered choices of k missed types give the probability and factorial moments (r)_k(1−kt)^m. In the critical window mt²≤(log r+O(1))/r, so for each fixed k the factorial moment tends to e^(−kc); the Poisson law is moment-determinate, and convergence of the zero mass follows by considering the distribution function at 1/2. Above threshold, the mean number missed is at most exp(log r−mt)→0. Below, the same logarithm expansion for k=1 gives a diverging mean, and (1−2t)^m≤(1−t)^(2m) makes distinct missed indicators negatively correlated or uncorrelated, so variance is at most the mean. This establishes all claimed probabilities for varying p without endpoint bounds. Independent weighted enumeration of exact extent intersections at p=1/3 and p=3/4 agreed with saturation and all factorial moments in four dimensions, including empty and single-object cases (e.g. r=3,m=4,p=1/3 gives 512/59049). Frozen reference 3 misattributes the 2020 paper to Dürrschnabel et al.; its authors are Felde, Hanika, and Stumme. This bibliographic error does not affect correctness of the formulas.
residual_risks: The finite cases are corroboration rather than proof of either asymptotics or arbitrary densities. The result does not address typical concept counts off the saturation event.

evidence: For fixed (r,m,p), the number L of nonnull columns is Bin(m,rt). Conditional on L, the nonnull labels are independent uniform coupons. E(L/r)=mt and Var(L/r)≤mt/r. Hence at mt=log r+c+o(1), L/r−log r→c in probability, with no lower bound on rt. Squeezing occupancy at deterministic times r(log r+c±ε) transfers the classical Poisson limit; the zero mass gives the Gumbel completion window.
For mt−log r→±∞, monotonicity in m and comparison to the fixed-c windows imply the two tails; integer rounding moves mt by at most t≤1/r.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Combining the known structural criterion and classical occupancy requires no new lemma about formality, dependence, or rare-event limits. Uniformity in p is a direct consequence of the thinning variance bound, even when rt→0.

evidence: The 2015 paper proves that a Boolean order embedding of B(k) forces a contranominal scale of dimension k, with the converse in the introductory discussion. For k=r the scale uses every object and its r columns are exactly the coatoms. A context with those columns has all 2^r extents by taking their intersections.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: All the lattice language reduces to the known contranominal criterion: with r objects, attaining 2^r extents makes the lattice precisely the power set, not merely a lattice of coincident cardinality. The scale criterion is thus not a new implication.

originality.rationale: Boolean saturation is the known full-size contranominal-scale criterion, and the rest is the uniform coupon collector with an independent null draw. The exact formula is direct occupancy inclusion–exclusion, and the whole varying-p critical window is a routine binomial thinning of the classical Poisson empty-urn limit. This is demonstrable implication, not a claim that the complete formula has already appeared with identical notation in formal-concept literature.
residual_risks: The journal version 10.1080/03081079.2017.1354798 was inaccessible and may contain additional overlap; no whole-document conclusion is asserted. The decision rests on positive evidence from the 2015 equivalence and classical coupon collector, not on this or any catalogue non-hit.

value.rationale: Boolean saturation is a motivated event for concept enumeration, but the exact threshold here is a routine application of two known facts. The coatom representation, null atom, and time change leave no new occupancy phenomenon, structural difficulty, or novel exact invariant after thinning. It is useful as an explanatory application, not as a separate research finding under the stated standard.
residual_risks: This assessment does not deny the practical relevance of the saturation benchmark or address non-iid context models, where the reduction could break.
